core: G2/M transition and DNA damage checkpoint
name: G2/M transition and p53-dependent DNA damage checkpoint
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, G2/M progression and the G2 DNA damage checkpoint; unlike the E2F/G1-S and APC/C confusables, the theme adds TP53 regulation, gamma-radiation response and Cdc25A degradation.

name: Synaptic transmission potentiation and sensorimotor gating
rationale: Members enhance glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission between neurons and include prepulse inhibition and nonassociative learning, which separate it from exploratory-behavior, spine-maintenance and synapse-assembly confusables.

name: Pre-rRNA processing and ribosomal subunit nuclear export
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA transcription, pre-rRNA cleavage, ribosome assembly and subunit export with MYC growth targets, restricted to ribosome biogenesis unlike confusables spanning Pol II/III transcription, splicing and snRNA processing.

name: Adult eating behavior regulation
rationale: All three members concern positive or negative control of adult feeding behavior, distinct from confusables on leptin signaling, orexin/sleep and nutrient-response appetite terms.

name: Zinc, copper and heavy metal ion homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members cover zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium and other metal transport, sensing (MTF1) and metallothionein detoxification, whereas confusables centre on iron, transferrin and heme handling.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription
name: RNA polymerase III and I transcription with pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members are Pol III tRNA/5S transcription steps, Pol I elongation/termination and pre-rRNA cleavage events, differing from confusables focused on Pol I initiation, rDNA chromatin control or snRNA transcription.

name: N-glycan glucose addition, trimming and oligosaccharide catabolism
rationale: Members cover UDP-glucose and dolichyl-phosphate-glucose supply, MOGS/MAN1B1 glycan trimming and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown, unlike confusables on dolichol-oligosaccharide mannosylation or amino-sugar metabolism.

name: Ornithine and arginine metabolism with cationic amino acid transport
rationale: Members concern ornithine, citrulline, arginine and aspartate metabolism around the urea cycle plus lysine/arginine/ornithine transport (SLC7A7, SLC25A15), which the urea-cycle and glutamate confusables lack.

name: Myelination and node of Ranvier axon-glial organization
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance plus neurofascin, NrCAM, ankyrin, paranodal and sodium-channel clustering at nodes, distinguishing it from L1-family adhesion and axon-regeneration confusables.

qualifier: host modulation of viral genome replication
name: Coronavirus replication with host modulation of viral genome replication
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase maturation, genome replication, capping and host translation interference, and uniquely include host-mediated and positive regulation of viral genome replication absent from the confusables.

name: ATF6 arm of the unfolded protein response
rationale: All members are ATF6-alpha/beta-driven chaperone induction, separating it from PERK/IRE1, XBP1/ATF4 and SREBP confusables.

name: Glucose and sterol sensing transcription via ChREBP and SREBP
rationale: Members are sugar-responsive ChREBP/carbon-catabolite transcription and SREBP-driven cholesterol programs, unlike confusables on PKA/AMPK metabolic phosphorylation, nuclear receptors or adipogenesis.

name: Xenobiotic efflux transport and cellular drug response
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic export across membranes and the blood-brain barrier together with antibiotic, cisplatin and drug responses, which the nucleoside, organic-ion and bile-salt transport confusables lack.

name: Cold- and diet-induced adaptive thermogenesis
rationale: All members concern heat production triggered by cold or diet, distinct from adipocyte differentiation, thermal pain perception and adrenergic confusables.

name: Arginine, ornithine and proline metabolism and basic amino acid transport
rationale: Members span ornithine/citrulline/arginine and proline metabolism plus lysine/arginine/ornithine transporters, unlike confusables on the urea cycle enzymes proper, glutamate/glutamine or glycine metabolism.

name: Canonical Wnt signaling at ligand secretion and receptor level
rationale: Members cover Wnt ligand biogenesis/PORCN, FZD ubiquitination by RNF43, LRP5, DVL activation and ligand antagonists, upstream of the destruction-complex/TCF and non-canonical calcium confusables.

name: Visual retinoid cycle in rods and cones
rationale: All members concern regeneration of 11-cis-retinal in photoreceptors (including RDH5 defect), distinct from general retinoid metabolism and phototransduction-cascade confusables.

name: p75NTR and dependence receptor death signaling
rationale: Members are pro-apoptotic signaling via p75NTR adaptors (NADE, NRAGE) and ligand-free dependence receptors, unlike confusables on p75NTR survival/TRK signaling or general neuronal apoptosis.

name: Chaperone-assisted protein refolding and aggregation prevention
rationale: Members cover protein refolding, ER folding, ATP-dependent chaperone activity and suppression of inclusion bodies, distinct from CCT/TRiC de novo folding, HSF1 heat response and aggrephagy confusables.

name: MicroRNA-mediated translational repression and mRNA deadenylation
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly, miRNA repression of specific mRNAs and deadenylation/P-body decay, unlike confusables on siRNA and miRNA processing control or lncRNA-mediated stabilization.

name: VEGFR2 and Tie2 signaling in sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members are endothelial proliferation, migration, survival and branching driven by VEGF/VEGFR2 and Tie2, which confusables focused on negative regulation, FGF or neuropilin lack.

name: Estrogen receptor-centred steroid hormone transcriptional response
rationale: Members are mainly estrogen receptor signaling and target genes plus progesterone/androgen responses and HSP90 receptor chaperoning, distinguishing it from androgen receptor-focused confusables.

name: Beta-catenin destruction complex phosphorylation and its oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members are the GSK3/CK1 beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and CTNNB1, AXIN and GSK3B mutants that escape it, unlike confusables on Wnt ligands, receptors and TCF transcription.

name: V-ATPase organelle acidification and melanosome pigmentation
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-driven acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles with melanin synthesis and pigment granule maturation, whereas confusables cover only pigmentation or only pH regulation.

name: Chk1/Chk2 G2/M checkpoint control of CDK1
rationale: Members are the G2/M DNA replication checkpoint in which Chk1/Chk2 inactivate Cyclin B:CDK1, distinct from p53, E2F/G1-S and S-phase replication confusables.
